description: This file defines a REST API resource class for handling audit-related requests in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for listing audits with filtering, retrieving specific audit entries by ID, and providing audit search templates. The class utilizes JAX-RS, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and services for security, serialization, and audit data retrieval.

classes.name: AuditsApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class for audit-related API endpoints, providing methods to list, retrieve, and search audit entries with filtering and pagination support.

methods.name: retrieveAuditEntries
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list audit entries with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: retrieveAuditEntry
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve details of a specific audit entry by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAuditSearchTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for building audit search UIs.

methods.name: getExtraCriteria
methods.description: Constructs SQL filter criteria based on the provided AuditRequest parameters.
